summary: prelude: a sub Fs denies Windows device names (NUL, COM1, CONIN$, ...) and colons under its root, so `http.file_server` cannot open a device (GO-2022-1143)
details: a sub Fs denies Windows device names (NUL, COM1, CONIN$, ...) and colons under its root, so `http.file_server` cannot open a device (GO-2022-1143). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
